summary: Second Remer lookout in Cass County, MN: a 100-ft Aermotor stairway tower erected in 1938. Listed as gone; no source describes the site today.

facts.status_note: Listed as gone; no source we read describes what remains at the site.

notes_for_editor: Gone status comes from the FFLA Minnesota list only; no source read gives a removal date, cause, or what remains at the site. Built year, 100 ft height and Aermotor stairway design come from two unsigned Wikimedia Commons catalog PDFs (no author named in the text read); height converted from 100 ft to 30.5 m, and the catalog does not say whether that is to the cab floor. Owner appears as state Forest Service then USFS; no transfer date given. The brief record matches the second Remer tower (47.03031, -94.03339). The first Remer lookout (47.04189, -93.98611, 81 ft ladder, possibly moved to the Blueberry site; the FFLA snapshots call it 'Remer #1' or 'Remer - first') is a separate tower and needs its own record. The NRHP form covers the ranger station, not the lookout, and its listing status was not checked. Staffing evidence is district-level recollection (1959-1961), not specific to this tower. Not reachable: the nhlr.org record (live fetch reset, not cached) and a Star Tribune article (HTTP 429).
